method: B (launch story), thin data. PPC Guru launched Search ~May 2026. Only three months exist (May-Jul 2026); no full quarter, so first complete month is the baseline.
genuine_lead_definition: PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM. Excludes OUTBOUND_CLICK (book_appointment_click), CONTACT/GET_DIRECTIONS/ENGAGEMENT/PAGE_VIEW (GBP local actions), and YouTube engagement categories.
headline_basis: First full months (May-Jun 2026) averaged ~13 genuine phone/form leads a month at ~$56 each, ~13% conversion rate. Early launch, thin data — flagged Needs Review.
caveats: Only three months of data; July 2026 dipped to 7 genuine leads but is the current in-progress month. Re-pull after Q3 2026 for a full-quarter story.
